hero.subtitle: Personalized classes to speak with confidence from week one.

about.intro: I'm Gesa, a native German teacher with a degree in pedagogy from the University of Hamburg.
about.p1: Over the years I've taught German and Spanish in very different settings — from the kindergarten at Colegio Alemán in Guadalajara to vocational schools in Hamburg — and that mix of experience taught me something key: there's no single way to learn a language. Every student needs their own pace and their own method.
about.p2: Since 2022 I've been teaching independently, designing every course around the student, just real conversation from day one. I'll guide you step by step along the way.
about.p3: I live between two languages and two cultures, and that's exactly what I want to share with you: not just grammar, but the fluency to hold your own with confidence.
about.closing: Outside the classroom I'm a mom, and when I'm not teaching you'll probably find me doing yoga, near the sea, or walking a dog — the one you see in the homepage photo is part of the team too.
